notes: Known test pages for the AI Web Annotator QA team. Each site stresses a different rendering/anchoring scenario. Span hints are instructions, not exact strings — page text drifts; find the closest match. Every Explain click is a real Gemini API call, so stick to the listed spans.

stresses: infoboxes and figures competing for layout

spans.hint: In the lead paragraph, select the phrase 'clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats' (or the closest technical phrase in the first paragraph)
Select one full sentence that contains a superscript citation marker (e.g. [1]) in the middle of it

expect: floating ✦ button appears adjacent to the selection, not off-screen
sidebar card renders a 2-4 sentence explanation with source links
highlight and card persist after page reload; citation superscript inside the span does not break anchoring

stresses: sticky sidebar/TOC that may collide with injected UI

spans.hint: Select a full sentence from the opening summary paragraph
Select a method name or short snippet INSIDE a code block (e.g. getRangeAt inside a <pre>)

expect: selection inside code blocks triggers the button and highlights render inside <pre> without breaking monospace layout
injected sidebar does not overlap or fight MDN's own sticky sidebar
persistence after reload for both spans

stresses: client-side routing (URL changes without full page load)

spans.hint: Select a sentence from the first prose paragraph of the Quick Start content

expect: after client-side navigating to another doc page and back (via sidebar links, no full reload), the highlight is restored or at minimum listed as orphaned — not silently lost

stresses: re-anchoring performance across thousands of text nodes

spans.hint: Select the famous opening line of Chapter 1 ('It is a truth universally acknowledged...')
Scroll roughly halfway down the book and select any complete sentence there

expect: no visible jank or long freeze when the content script re-anchors on reload
the mid-page highlight restores at the correct occurrence, not an earlier duplicate phrase
sidebar scroll-to-annotation works across a very long page

spans.hint: Select the text of one comment (a full sentence from any comment body)

expect: button placement is usable despite cramped line-height
highlight does not distort the table layout

spans.hint: Select a sentence of body copy (not a heading) on the landing page
Select part of a large hero heading
spans.custom_question: What product is this describing, in one sentence?

expect: highlight color remains legible against the dark background (text must stay readable)
floating button and tooltip are visible and styled sanely on dark pages
custom-question mode returns an answer card like explain mode does
